info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 47h online + 3h offline (optional) + 1h Final exam + 99h self-study
info.description: The Entrepreneurship Specialization examines the entrepreneurial mindset and skill sets, indicators of innovation opportunities, critical steps to bring innovations to the marketplace, and innovation strategies to establish and maintain a competitive advantage. Fundamentals of new venture financing are explored with attention to capital structures for new ventures, term sheets and how to negotiate them, and the differences between early-stage versus later-stage financing. You will develop an understanding of how to develop winning investor pitches, who and when to pitch, how to avoid common mistakes, and how to ‘get to the close’. In the final Capstone Project, you will apply the tools and concepts from the specialization courses by crafting a comprehensive, customer-validated business model, and creating a business plan and investor pitch.
info.studentTasks: Access the specialization on Coursera and complete all courses' requirements to earn a certificate of completion for the specialization, in order to be qualified for the Final Exam.
info.note: Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

clos.loDetails: Understand how to develop great ideas into great companies.
Understand how to create strategies to bring innovations to market and to develop an innovation portfolio and business model canvas for your venture.
Understand how to secure funding for your venture.
Integrate the tools and concepts from the specialization courses to develop a comprehensive business plan.
